cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Raise the Impossibility
cards.instruction: Answer every strange offer with a more committed version that you can still justify.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I left blank names beside yours. Invisible companions, naturally. I'll give your invisible wedding guest a whole table.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I hadn't asked her name. Her family walks through walls; they tend to wander.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Names later. I'll rent a ballroom that follows them. Nobody should miss cake.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Our ballroom can split itself when guests wander apart.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll order a cake that multiplies with it. Every room deserves the first slice.
